en: A black-and-white image showing a broad street of a town or small city with several mid-century cars parked on either side. The street is wide and appears to be dusty or lightly paved. There is a prominent building with a distinctive tower or spire partially visible among a cluster of trees, and other low-rise commercial buildings in the background. The signage on one building prominently features 'GOODYEAR.' The scene is sunlit, typical of a dry or semi-arid climate, with mountains faintly visible in the distant background.
